subject: P04
required_fixes: R1 (remaining) — Capture the reset epoch before asynchronous planning, rather than letting an old request acquire the new epoch. send.rs:414-428 reads the open document and private environment, then awaits blocking rendering at :443-464, and only afterward samples Sending.epoch at :466-471. Reset may clear that collection and advance the epoch during this await. For context=null, send_destinations (:299-306) succeeds without checking the closed collection or Resetting state. The pre-reset request is then stamped with the post-reset epoch. It has not entered Sending.runs yet, so reset's cancellation misses it; dispatch registers a fresh uncancelled token, and transfer/fenced see the matching new epoch. An ordinary request can consequently proceed after reset and recreate history/body/key storage despite the new fence; a registered mutation can republish a pending review from the cleared document. Bind the admitted call or initial document snapshot to its original epoch, preserve it across every await, and reject retired planning before publishing a review or dispatching. Acceptance: a deterministic production-interface fixture holds a context-null Send after document capture but before epoch sampling/render completion, admits reset, resumes planning, and verifies that the old request is refused, no review/run or target traffic appears, and private files/key/history/cookies stay removed after reset and restart. Retain the existing held-storage-step and dirty-cookie reset tests.
limitations: Read-only cumulative re-review: no application source was changed, no builds/tests or endpoints were launched, and no credentials were accessed. The remaining planning/reset interleaving is source-traced; its proposed deterministic fixture was not executed by the reviewer.
